scope: Proposition 6.3 (Far estimate) of the manuscript “Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility” (preprints/Quantitative-Near-Kerr-Evolution-and-Generic-C2-Future-Inextendibility-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cd38cc55e3c203a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 65. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After giving the finitely many commuted energies fixed hierarchy weights, there is c1 > 0 such that F ≤ oR0 (1)(F + Sa) + C(R0)KR + Cfix ( input errors + N1+c1 ) . (6.25) The coefficient denoted by oR0 (1) tends to zero as R0 → ∞, independently of the upper compact matching radius R. The input errors vanish with ein, uniformly on bounded small bootstrap ranges.
